name: OmniEAR / EAR-Bench
summary: 评测智能体对物理交互、工具使用和多智能体协调推理能力的文本具身场景基准。
summaryEn: A text-based embodied benchmark for reasoning about physical interactions, tool use, and multi-agent coordination.
scaleZh: 1,500 个场景和 1,982 条专家轨迹样本
organizationsZh: 浙江大学 REAL 实验室
licenseZh: 代码采用 MIT；数据许可见发布页
access: Benchmark data in repository and expert trajectories on Hugging Face
accessZh: 仓库提供基准数据，Hugging Face 提供专家轨迹
verdict: 把连续物理属性、工具能力和协作策略纳入具身推理评测
verdictEn: Evaluates embodied reasoning over continuous physics, tool capabilities, and coordination strategies
wmNote: 自动生成场景和专家轨迹适合研究符号化世界状态与规划。
wmNoteEn: Generated scenarios and expert trajectories support symbolic world-state modeling and planning.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - ZJU-REAL/OmniEmbodied: [ICLR 2026 LLM Reasoning Workshop] Benchmarking agent reasoning capabilities in physical interactions, tool usage, and multi-agent coordination. · GitHub
evidence.statement: OmniEAR/EAR-Bench supplies a structured-state simulator and expert trajectories for physically constrained action execution. Rename to match the official repository; paper title differs across revisions.
